# LLM Information File for Zarewa ERP
# This file provides information about Zarewa ERP to language models and AI assistants.

## Project Information
Project Name: Zarewa ERP
Description: Comprehensive enterprise resource planning system for managing sales, inventory, finance, HR, and operations
Website: https://zarewa.app
Type: Web Application (SPA)
Framework: React 19, Vite 8, React Router 7, Tailwind CSS 4

## Key Features
- Sales Management: Quotations, receipts, refunds, advance payments
- Inventory Management: Stock tracking, production monitoring, material management
- Financial Management: Account management, treasury management, financial reporting
- HR Management: Employee management, payroll, performance tracking
- Operations: Production monitoring, workflow management
- Business Intelligence: Dashboards, analytics, reporting

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript-ready JSX
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion
- State Management: React Context, TanStack Query
- Routing: React Router 7
- UI Components: Radix UI, Lucide Icons
- Charts: Recharts
- Data Processing: XLSX (Excel)
- Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library
- Backend: Node.js HTTP API (separate deployment)
- Authentication: Firebase Auth

## Key URLs
- Main Application: https://zarewa.app
- API Base: https://api.zarewa.app (configured via VITE_API_BASE)
- Sitemap: https://zarewa.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://zarewa.app/robots.txt

## Architecture Notes
- Single Page Application (SPA) with client-side routing
- All routes fall back to index.html for client-side handling
- API communication via /api proxy in development, VITE_API_BASE in production
- Code splitting optimized for login performance
- Critical path excludes heavy modules (desk, AI, xlsx, charts)

## API Information
- Base Path: /api
- Authentication: Firebase Auth + Session cookies (zarewa_csrf)
- Communication: REST HTTP endpoints
- CORS: Credentials included, requires matching backend configuration

## SEO Information
- Canonical URL: https://zarewa.app
- Application Type: WebApplication (schema.org)
- Keywords: ERP, enterprise resource planning, sales, inventory, finance, HR
- Language: English (en)
- Mobile Friendly: Yes (responsive design)

## Accessibility Features
- Semantic HTML
- ARIA labels for status indicators
- Loading states with appropriate screen reader announcements
- Reduced motion support
- Keyboard navigation support

## Performance Optimizations
- Code splitting by module (sales, finance, HR, etc.)
- Tree-shaking of unused code
- Self-hosted fonts to avoid external CDN calls
- WebP image formats where supported
- Module preloading strategy for critical paths
- No source maps in production

## Contact & Support
For technical questions about Zarewa ERP deployment and usage, contact your system administrator.
